articles.description:

articles.description:

articles.title: TRACE: A Multi-Layer Benchmark for Human AI Controller Coordination Under Drift and Failure
articles.description:
arXiv:2608.06657v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modern cyber-physical and AI-assisted systems couple human operators, AI decision modules, and automated controllers in a single control loop, so trustworthiness depends on the whole loop, not any one model. Yet no standard benchmark captures time-aligned, multi-layer traces of how drift and failures propagate across these layers, so we cannot diagnose where coordination breaks down, why, or how to recover. This paper targets one facet of that gap
articles.title_zh: TRACE: A Multi-Layer Benchmark for Human AI Controller Coordination Under Drift and Failure

articles.title: Shape Your Feed: An LLM-based Agentic System for Conversational Recommendation
articles.description:
arXiv:2608.06632v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Industrial recommendation systems predominantly adopt a passive ranking paradigm that infers user preferences from implicit behavioral signals (e.g., clicks, dwell time) rather than explicit, natural language inputs. articles.title: Divergent Response Modes in Frontier Language Models Under Steering Pressure
articles.description:

articles.title: KNOWPLAN: Knowledge-Driven AI Agents for Smart Degree Pathway Planning
articles.description:

articles.description:
